column4: Wide shot of the cathedral nave (third reference) from the stage end, empty pews, stone floor. At the left-center a tall LIVING LIBRARIAN stands in profile facing right: she wears exactly the librarian outfit of the FIRST reference (white blouse with black ribbon bow and orange brooch, long layered ivory, orange and black skirt, lace-up ankle boots, orange hair with a flower), natural skin, no maid apron, no ruffled headband. She holds her right hand out horizontally toward a SMALLER porcelain maid doll (SECOND reference: black dress, white apron, white headband, white boots) standing on the right of her at about three-quarters of her height, who holds her hand out toward the librarian; their fingertips almost meet at the center of the frame. On the far right wall one cell of the puppet-theater (last reference) has a small doll leaning out with one arm stretched toward the left. From the far right edge a large bare ball-jointed porcelain hand enters horizontally, reaching left. No strings or threads, no text.
